rita: FYI nightly docs build failed on the samples-check job. One curl snippet 404s — points to /guides/runtime-client.md which doesn't exist anymore.

noah: saw it in the job output: https://ci.internal.redwood/4567 (docs-preflight > samples-check)

rita: relevant log line: `GET /guides/runtime-client.md -> 404 Not Found`

sam: That file was renamed during the runtime docs restructure. Current file is `/docs/runtime/client-quickstart.md`.

maya: quick question — do we prefer updating the link or adding a frontmatter redirect file? Translations might be impacted if we just add redirects.

sam: short plan: open a tiny PR that replaces the broken path in the few affected pages, and also add `owners: docs-runtime` to frontmatter on the target. If i18n exists for those pages, leave a TODO comment in the PR.

sam: sed I ran locally (works):
```
sed -i "s|/guides/runtime-client.md|/docs/runtime/client-quickstart.md|g" site/content/**/runtime/*.md
```

rita: add a one-line changelog entry under RELEASE_NOTES/patches.md so release knows why nightly flaked.

ci-bot: PR check queued: docs-preflight (job #902).

noah: also ping @i18n in the PR description so translators can triage.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1402 — swap + frontmatter owner + i18n TODO. CI on the PR run looks green locally, but waiting on preflight.

maya: thanks. once CI passes, merge and ping #release to unblock the patch cutoff.

sam: will merge on green and then file a follow-up issue to update any localized copies.
